title: credential fallthrough + per-language ergonomic adapters + unified stream backoff presets (SDK bumps)
author: Aisha Romero
description: Introduce a credential fallthrough chain and per-language ergonomic adapters for streaming clients, add unified backoff preset profiles and telemetry tags, and bump Python/TS/Go SDK versions. Motivation: teams repeatedly implement custom credential cascades and slightly different streaming ergonomics across languages; this PR centralizes the policy, provides idiomatic adapters for each SDK, and ships tested backoff presets so production apps can pick sensible defaults. Changes include a new CredFallthrough interface, language adapters (py: CredentialChain, ts: CredComposer, go: CascadeProvider), a StreamBackoffProfile enum shared by all SDKs, streaming hook for graceful reconnects and telemetry labels for credential sources. Also includes migration shims and deprecation warnings so existing callers continue to work. See release notes and migration guidance.

release_notes: SDKs: Introduce credential fallthrough chain and per-language adapters for streaming clients; add StreamBackoffProfile presets (aggressive/balanced/latency-first); bump versions: python v3.4.0, typescript v4.9.0, go v1.11.0. Includes migration guide and examples.
migration_notes: Existing SDK users: no immediate code changes required. New defaults wire the CredFallthrough chain only when multiple credential sources are configured; single-source setups are unaffected. Recommended migration: adopt CredentialChain when you rely on multiple token sources (env, file cache, delegated token server). See docs/guides/migration/credential-fallthrough.md for examples per language.
tests_summary: Added unit tests for credential chain failure modes, stream reconnect scenarios, and end-to-end integration tests exercising backoff presets across the streaming matrix (py/ts/go). Existing streaming integration matrix re-run; one flaky test (stream_buffer_edgecase) increased timeout and stabilized.
notes_for_release_manager: This PR includes cross-SDK version bumps. Coordinate with the release pipeline to publish PyPI wheels, npm packages, and Go modules in the same release window. Docs update included; please ensure docs site build picks up the new migration guide. No runtime feature flags required.
compatibility: Backward compatible: default behavior unchanged for single-provider credential configs. New APIs are additive (CredentialChain/CredComposer/CascadeProvider). Deprecation: internal 'legacy_token_adapter' is deprecated and will be removed in two releases.
oss_impacts: None outside SDKs; no server-side API changes. The README examples were updated; maintainers of community adapters should adapt to new backoff profile names (aggressive|balanced|latency-first).
performance_considerations: Backoff presets tuned for common production patterns. 'aggressive' reduces retry interval for low-latency failure recovery, may increase request rate under widespread outages. Recommend 'balanced' for general-purpose services.

developer_notes: If you plan to extend credential sources, implement the CredSource interface and add it to the chain via CredentialChain.add_source(...). Keep providers idempotent and side-effect free. For streaming adapters, prefer the StreamBackoffProfile enum to configure client backoff instead of custom timers.
